sentences.text:
Rup vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 17 November, 2023
03 17.11.
 2023 Crr 450 of 2015
 Ct
237
 Sudhir Singh & Ors.
rup Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee,

Mr. Koustav Lal Mukherjee,
 Mr. Abhijit Singh ... for the petitioner.

Mr. Swapan Banerjee,
 Mr. Suman De ... for the State.

1.
This is an application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure with a prayer for
quashing of criminal proceeding in respect of G.R. Case No.1198 of 2014 arose out of Uluberia Police
Station Case No. 387 of 2014 dated 24th May, 2014 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian
Penal Code.

2.  Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee, learned advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that the de- facto complainant filed same nature of complaint before the Officer-in-Charge of Women Police Station, Raipur Chattisgarh.

3. Mr. Swapan Banerjee, learned advocate appearing on behalf of the State has relied on the evidence collected in course of investigation of the case in connection with Uluberia Police Station Case No. 387 of 2014 dated 24th May, 2014.

4. Considering all facts and circumstances, Officer-In- Charge of Uluberia Police Station is directed to obtain a certified copy of the written complaint filed before the Officer-In-Charge, Women Police Station, Raipur Chattisgarh and to submit a report to that effect before this court on the returnable date.

5. Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the State is directed to pursue the matter so that the report is received from the Officer-In-Charge, Uluberia Police Station positively by the returnable date.

6. Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner is directed to supply a copy of the notice issued by Officer-In-Charge, Women Police Station, Raipur Chattisgarh to the Officer-In-Charge,
Uluberia Police Station through State for its onwards transmission to the concerned Officer-In-Charge, Women Police Station.
